tagline: Give your computer a voice — offline text-to-speech that serves every app, no key, no cloud.
description:
Pocket Voice is a PROVIDER app: install it, keep it in your Providers folder, and assign it to the Text → speech AI type in Settings → AI models. From then on, every app that asks GifOS to speak — Reader, games, anything using the ai ability — is answered by this app, entirely on your device.

The voice is eSpeak, the classic compact formant synthesizer, compiled to JavaScript and sealed inside the GifOS sandbox with zero network access. The engine and its English (US) voice data (~5.6 MB) are downloaded once at install and hash-verified by GifOS — after that it works on a plane, in a basement, anywhere.

Seven voice variants respond to the familiar names apps already use (nova, shimmer, fable, echo, onyx, alloy, whisper). It is not a neural voice — it is the honest, robotic, instant kind that never bills you and never hears you.
author: GifOS
